thread:
pagerbot: PagerDuty alert fired -> prod-inference-gateway (eu-west1) 
pagerbot: symptom: 5xx error-rate spike (5m = 6.8%, baseline <0.5%)
pagerbot: triggered policy: http_5xx_rate > 1% for 5m
pagerbot: links: https://pd.example.com/incidents/INC12345, runbook: https://confluence.example.com/display/INF/5xx-runbook

Theo: who picked up the PD?
Priya: @Theo I just got the page, taking lead. looking at graphs now.
Ravi: I'm online, can assist with routing & pools.

Priya: quick glance - error codes are majority 502/504 from router layer back to tokenizer-service.
Priya: affected path: /v1/generate -> tokenization client -> model-backend; spikes started ~2m ago and slope steep.
Priya: sample log: ```ERROR: tokenizer-client timeout after 2.5s id=abc123 route=eu-west1 backend=tok-v2```

Theo: rolling canary deployed 10m ago? that might align. Any recent config changes?
Ravi: canary rollout for tok-v2 at 20% traffic in eu-west1 started ~15m ago. Noticed increased latencies in perf dashboard 5m ago.

Priya: mitigation plan: 1) divert canary traffic to stable tok-v1 (weight -> 0%), 2) scale tokenizer-service replicas + increase request timeout to 6s, 3) clear client KV cache on edge if needed.
Priya: executing step 1 now: ```kubectl -n prod set image deployment/tokenizer-canary tokenizer=tok:v1 --record``` (using canary controller UI to revert weights)
Priya: status: revert initiated, weight draining... :hourglass_flowing_sand:

pagerbot: PD note: incident acknowledged by Priya (oncall). Escalation suppressed.

Ravi: scaling tokenizer pool by +3 pods (prod tokenizers autoscale at 5->8). ```kubectl -n prod scale deployment/tokenizer --replicas=8```
Ravi: also bumping nginx proxy keepalive to 100 to reduce tcp churn. patch applied.

Theo: Support check: any customer-facing 429/5xx rate-limited errors? SupportBot, pull recent customer impact table?
SupportBot: summary: total requests failed (5m): 12.3k, failed requests with customer id present: 1.1k sessions affected across 8 enterprise customers. Estimated % of traffic: ~2.8% EU region. No global data loss.

Priya: after divert and scale, errors trending down. 5m error-rate now 2.1% (was 6.8%). Latency p95 for tokenizers down from 1.8s -> 0.9s.

Ravi: restarting tokenizer pods with new image to ensure no stale dependency: ```kubectl rollout restart deployment/tokenizer -n prod```

Theo: good. I propose a short customer advisory for impacted customers and a postmortem action item to improve canary throttling.
Priya: Agreed. I'll draft an incident summary and queue for postmortem. immediate actions: revert canary (done), scale up (done), restart pods (in progress).

pagerbot: Note: PagerDuty incident INC12345 still open and assigned to Priya.

Priya: handing off to @Ravi for follow-up monitoring and final checks. I'm going offline in 15m but will be reachable for questions.
Ravi: ack. I'll keep an eye for 30m and post stabilization checkin.

Ravi: 15m checkin: metrics stable, error-rate steady ~0.4% (within baseline). I'll close on PD once we confirm no regression in next 30m.

Theo: follow-ups for postmortem: - tighten canary ramping rules (max error budget), - add synthetic traffic test for tokenizer before canary promotion, - alert to include tokenizer request id sample.
Priya: adding runbook note: add immediate rollback hook for canary by traffic weight toggle in console.

Ravi: closing timeline planned after 30m stable window. tagging SRE rotation for handoff. :white_check_mark:
